## What's the user-visible change

One sentence.

## Why

What problem does this solve, for whom?

## Sketch of the UX

CLI command? UI surface? Config flag? Be concrete.

## Out-of-scope check

The following are deliberately not in v0 (see `planning/01-ceo-review.md`). If your request falls into one, it likely belongs in v0.2+ or in the hosted version, not the OSS:

- Auth / multi-user / team sharing
- Cloud sync, S3 export, anything that egresses beyond the proxied connection
- Email / Slack alerts
- ML / anomaly detection
- Non-MCP protocols
- Telemetry of any kind

If your idea is in this list and you still want it in OSS, please make the case explicitly.

## Alternatives considered

What did you try / consider before opening this?
